### Caught Up in the Clouds
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/caught-up-in-the-clouds
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 4:17-18
Points:
- Believers who pass away before Christ returns will not miss out on the blessings of His kingdom.
- The resurrection of Jesus guarantees the future bodily resurrection and preservation of all who trust Him.
- At the Lord's return, the dead in Christ rise first, followed by living believers caught up together with them.
- Meeting Christ in the air depicts believers welcoming their returning King like a royal delegation.
- Paul shared this doctrine to bring deep comfort in grief rather than to encourage speculative debates.
